(4) The main character, a woman in a white suit, is seen walking past a window and looking over some papers, appearing to prepare for the event. (5) Various quick cuts show fans taking selfies, a girl in a white outfit posing in front of the pink backdrop, and another fan wearing a large red pepper-shaped plush hat. (6) The main character enters the stage area, waving energetically to the audience. (7) She stands in front of the backdrop, making heart gestures and smiling. (10) A final wide group shot shows the main character crouching in front of the entire cheering crowd, everyone making finger hearts.
